{{Top|leg}}
The '''Command Division''' was a [[Division/Legends|division]]-level unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. The Command Division was representative of all the individual [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]] and was assigned to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. A [[Wilderness Fighters]] regiment was assigned to the High Command base, while [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marine]] and [[Heavy Weapons Specialists]] regiments were station on the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. The other regiments saw service with other [[Supreme Command]]s; [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] made use of both the [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrator]] and [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] regiments while [[Starfighter Command (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Starfighter Command]] used a mixed force for technical support and ground security. The Command Division answered to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
